displayName: 露姬蝙蝠 Rouge the Bat
description: Unofficial Rouge the Bat fan art from Sonic the Hedgehog, with a modest opaque black suit, white gloves and boots, and two purple bat wings. Original animations feature a soft translucent bead, cloth placement and recovery, quiet clasp inspection, ear tilts, low wing-assisted hops, and articulated steps in three directions. Neutral proportions and safe rounded props.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
